items.source: Subclass of ProtobufHttpMessageConverter which enforces the use of Protobuf 3 and its official library "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util" for JSON processing.
items.translation: `ProtobufHttpMessageConverter` 的子类，强制使用 Protobuf 3 及其官方库 `com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util` 进行 JSON 处理。

items.source: Implementation of HttpMessageConverter that can read and write Protocol Buffers using kotlinx.serialization.
items.translation: 实现能够使用 kotlinx.serialization 读写 Protocol Buffers 的 HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: An HttpMessageConverter that reads and writes com.google.protobuf.Messages using Google Protocol Buffers.
items.translation: 一个使用Google Protocol Buffers读取和写入com.google.protobuf.Messages的HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: Provides an HttpMessageConverter implementation for handling Google Protocol Buffers.
items.translation: 提供用于处理 Google Protocol Buffers 的 HttpMessageConverter 实现。

items.source: Provides an HttpMessageConverter abstraction to convert between Java objects and HTTP input/output messages.
items.translation: 提供 HttpMessageConverter 抽象，用于在 Java 对象和 HTTP 输入/输出消息之间进行转换。

items.source: Contract to enable subclasses to plug in support for additional formats.
items.translation: 用于使子类能够插入对额外格式支持的契约。
